latest_interim.detail: Q3 2026: organic +2.6% (price +2.1%, volume/mix +0.5%); reported +2.5%. New segments (from 8-Jan-2026 operating-model change): North America +2.5, Europe -0.6, APAC +3.9, International +6.9; Oral Health +8.8%. A segment table labelled nine months 2026 also shows organic 2.6% (price 2.1, vol/mix 0.5) - not cross-checked. FY2026 guidance cut to organic ~2.5% (TARGET); adjusted operating profit high-single-digit cc growth reiterated.

geography.basis_note: Revenue by geography (GBP m): UK 374 (3.4%), US & Puerto Rico 3,468 (31.4%), China 999 (9.1%), Rest of World 6,189 (56.1%) of 11,030. Segments 2025: North America 3,866 (35.0%), EMEA & LatAm 4,592 (41.6%), APAC 2,572 (23.3%). Europe-only share not disclosed for 2025 (new 'Europe' segment from 2026: Q3-26 GBP798m of 2,868m = 27.8%). China described as 'our second-largest market'.

claim_checks.finding: 2022 +9.0% (price 4.3, vol/mix 4.7) confirmed; 2023 was +8.0% (price 7.0, vol/mix 1.0), not 7.9%; 2024 +5.0% (price 3.7, vol/mix 1.3) confirmed. Volume/mix has decelerated from 4.7pp (2022) to 0.5pp (Q3 2026): growth is now overwhelmingly price-led.

FY2025 20-F: China revenue GBP999m = 9.1% of group (2024: GBP987m; 2023: GBP966m); Haleon calls China its second-largest market and acquired the remaining stake in its China JV in 2025. Q3-26 was hit by a raw-material classification change for Centrum OTC products in China.

claim_checks.claim: FY2026 organic guidance ~2.5% and Q3-26 2.6% (price 2.1, vol/mix 0.5)
claim_checks.finding: Confirmed verbatim in the Q3 2026 trading statement ('Organic revenue growth: Now expected to be around 2.5%'), versus the 4-6% medium-term target.
